# `mise config`

- **Usage:** `mise config [FLAGS] <SUBCOMMAND>`
- **Aliases:** `cfg`, `toml`
- **Effect:** read-only
- **Source code:** [`src/cli/config/mod.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/config/mod.rs)

Manage config files

## Flags
- **`-J --json`** — Output in JSON format
- **`--no-header`** — Do not print table header
- **`--tracked-configs`** — List all tracked config files
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Subcommands

- [`mise config get [FLAGS] [KEY]`](/cli/config/get.md)
- [`mise config ls [FLAGS]`](/cli/config/ls.md)
- [`mise config set [FLAGS] <KEY> [VALUE]`](/cli/config/set.md)
